overloads.semanticRole: Sets the entire HTTP reply header from a single pre-formatted Text field/variable (header), allowing arbitrary header lines such as status lines and Set-Cookie.
Sets the HTTP reply header field-by-field from two parallel arrays: fieldArray holds the header field names and valueArray holds their corresponding values, at matching positions.

jointConstraints.rule: fieldArray and valueArray must have the same size; each fieldArray[i] is paired with valueArray[i] as one header field/value.

constraints: Only has an effect within a Web process.
header must be a 4D variable or field (a literal Text constant is rejected); header fields must be separated by CR or CR+LF.
